hooks.name: TechLead No Source Write
hooks.description: Hard-blocks the TechLead orchestrator from writing src/**/*.cs files. Only AGENTS.md and .kiro/** are allowed for direct editing.

action.command: pwsh -NoProfile -Command "$json = $input | Out-String | ConvertFrom-Json; $p = $json.tool_input.path; if ($p -match '[/\\]src[/\\].*\.cs$') { [Console]::Error.WriteLine('BLOCKED: TechLead may not write src/**/*.cs. Delegate to a subagent via run_workflow.'); exit 2 }; exit 0"
